sharedEditsNeeded: packages/containers/src/wav.ts, aiff.ts and au.ts: set info.metadata for inputs whose native demuxer exports tags (WAV LIST/INFO, AIFF NAME/ANNO, AU annotation). Probed: native writes them in the CAF info chunk, EdgeFFmpeg accepts the tagged input and writes none (the same inputs into the wav, aiff and au muxers already differ). Not fixable inside caf.ts.
notes: Sandbox Node was v22.23.5; bootstrap requires Node 24, so /opt/node24 (v24.22.3) was used for every command.

Setup durations: bootstrap (npm, submodule, reference) 4m20s after a first attempt failed in 0.6s on Node 22; baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+registry tests 1m24s. Differential file runs in about 9 s.
The sandbox ffmpeg sha differs from the linux-x64 pin (bootstrap --allow-unpinned-reference); tests assert only commit 946fcce0 and --disable-x86asm from build-metadata.json.
INVALIDDATA (183) is not errno-based, so no host errno mapping is needed.
Native leaves an empty output file on the 183 refusal; EdgeFFmpeg creates none.

Audit (audit-fmt-b): the claim that tagged inputs never reach the info chunk holds only for inputs flagged with info.metadata; tagged WAV, AIFF and AU inputs are not flagged by the pre-registry demuxers and diverge silently (see sharedEditsNeeded; probed on macOS arm64 against the darwin reference, sha256 1b86106f…ab92). Every other probe of this audit (guessed, unknown and single-speaker layouts, 3-6 channel AU/WAV/AIFF/SoX inputs, -guess_layout_max, rates 1 to 2^31-1, empty inputs, time selection) matched native.
